pages.title: Glyptodon
pages.text: The Glyptodon ($(o)Glyptodon clavipes$()) is an extinct armoured mammal that lived in South America during the Pleistocene, disappearing at its end.$(br2)A distant relative of armadillos, it was roughly the size of a small car, protected by a rigid domed shell made of more than a thousand fused bony plates.$(br2)Glyptodon was a herbivore that grazed on grasses and low plants, and its tail was encased in rings of bone.
